conclusion: Not behaviorally equivalent. Measured raw predictions and metrics differ materially; live LLM end-to-end parity was not tested.

findings.title: DLinear initialization, defaults and batch RNG differ
findings.old: Seasonal/trend weights start at 1/seq_len; default learning_rate=0.0001; train_epochs/moving_avg names; torch DataLoader shuffle.
findings.lite: Random Linear weights; default learning_rate=0.001; epochs/kernel names; direct torch.randperm batching.
findings.impact: Same mapped explicit epochs/lr/seed still produces materially different validation/test predictions.

findings.title: Multivariate input becomes target-only input
findings.old: All completely numeric CSV columns are standardized and participate in neural model training.
findings.lite: Only target_col is loaded into Data.y; remaining numeric columns do not participate in training.
findings.impact: The full 7-feature ETTh1 task is numerically different. Lite univariate and multivariate cases produce the same target predictions.

findings.title: Holt/ARIMA fit and forecasting regimes differ
findings.old: Optimized statsmodels Holt; ARIMA defaults (1,1,1), unconstrained stationarity/invertibility; forecasts from the training boundary, sliced into evaluation windows.
findings.lite: Holt fixed alpha/beta, recomputed from each recent history; ARIMA defaults (2,0,1), default constraints, apply each recent history before forecasting.
findings.impact: Both training objective and information used at each evaluation origin differ; lower new error would not establish a like-for-like improvement.

findings.title: Final delivery model selection rule differs
findings.old: Select a validation representative per family; test each representative and deliver the lowest raw test MSE model.
findings.lite: Lock the global lowest validation MSE model before testing and test only that model.
findings.impact: Identical experiment histories can deliver different models.

findings.title: Chronos default weights and inference aggregation differ
findings.old: amazon/chronos-bolt-base, BaseChronosPipeline, GPU bfloat16, sample/quantile mean.
findings.lite: amazon/chronos-t5-tiny, ChronosPipeline, CPU float32, sample median.
findings.impact: The same Chronos model name identifies a different base model. Not numerically tested here.

findings.title: Agent prompts, compaction, adjustment rules and evidence controller were simplified
findings.old: Detailed domain roles, LLM/artifact compaction, conditional/exogenous adjustment rules, richer context and calibrated safety/evidence transitions.
findings.lite: Short role prompts, extractive history notes, affine/horizon/clip rules, reduced window context and min/max/step constraints.
findings.impact: The same LLM and task configuration would receive different inputs and tools. End-to-end semantic parity is not established.

findings.title: Floating-point path and zero-denominator serialization differ
findings.old: CSV numeric values cast to float32 before StandardScaler; undefined WAPE/MASE return Infinity.
findings.lite: Python float64 values and statistics; undefined WAPE/MASE return null.
findings.impact: Measured target scale differences are around 2.14e-7 and do not explain large model error changes; degenerate metrics need an explicit compatibility decision.
